title: Camoufox Scraper
description: Camoufox Scraper loads Start URLs using Camoufox browser through Playwright and then executes Page function for each page to extract data from it. To follow links and scrape additional pages, set Link selector with Link patterns to specify which links to follow. Alternatively, you can manually enqueue new links in the Page function. For details, see the actor's README.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: A static list of URLs to scrape.

sleepTimeBeforeChallenge.title: Sleep time before Cloudflare challenge [s]
sleepTimeBeforeChallenge.description: Specifies how long after navigation to the page Cloudflare challenge is clicked.

requestTimeout.title: Request timeout
requestTimeout.description: The maximum duration (in seconds) for the request to complete before timing out. The timeout value is passed to the httpx.AsyncClient object.

camoufoxPlugin.title: Camoufox Plugin
camoufoxPlugin.description: A Python code defining Camoufox plugin and all it's options.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Specifies proxy servers that will be used by the scraper in order to hide its origin.
